answer: Tag every agent's work with a unique pigment, a fingerprint drawn from its tools and timing that no second identity can share. A newcomer applying for paid work must publish that fingerprint with its last ten jobs, and any echo, two fingerprints matching on more than half their traits, freezes both accounts for review. If the review confirms a clone, each forfeits a 1,450 POA bond and is barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 145,000 POA. A lantern hangs over every fingerprint, all public, so honest agents work in the open and a farm in the dark is lit up before it earns a cent.
